# Australian Business Startup

> Free plain-English guides and a newsletter for people starting and running small businesses in Australia, plus an 80,000+ member Facebook group. Operated by Enviga Pty Ltd (ABN 43 115 695 568). General information, not legal, financial or tax advice.

Australian Business Startup (https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/) is a free resource for Australian founders. The Facebook group started in December 2015: https://www.facebook.com/groups/AusBusStart. The website publishes guides that link to official sources (business.gov.au, the Australian Business Register, ASIC, the ATO) and a public summary of scams aimed at new businesses. The longer Scam Watch guide is emailed to newsletter subscribers and is not the public page.

Contact: admin@australianbusinessstartup.com.au. Post: PO Box 58, Burleigh Heads QLD 4220, Australia.

Figures on the guides were checked in October 2026. Fees are indexed and grant rounds change, so quote the linked government page for the current amount.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/): Start-a-business guides, the newsletter, and the free Scam Watch offer.
- [About](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/about.html): Who runs the site and the Facebook group, and how to contact them.
- [Guides](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/guides/): Index of the practical Australian start-up guides.
- [How to start a business in Australia](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/guides/how-to-start-a-business-in-australia.html): The usual order of steps, from structure and ABN to tax, licences and records.
- [How to apply for an ABN](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/guides/how-to-apply-for-an-abn.html): The 11-digit Australian Business Number is free to register and is not a yearly renewal.
- [How to register a business name](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/guides/register-a-business-name.html): When ASIC requires a business name, and the published fee.
- [Sole trader, partnership or company](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/guides/sole-trader-partnership-or-company.html): How the three common structures differ on tax, liability and fees.
- [Small business grants and support](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/guides/small-business-grants-australia.html): Where to look for free grant information, and how to spot grant scams.
- [GST registration basics](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/guides/gst-registration-basics.html): The 10% tax, the $75,000 turnover threshold, and who must register sooner.
- [Scam Watch summary](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/scam-watch-summary.html): Short public notes on the scams that target new Australian businesses, and where to report them.
- [Tools we recommend](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/tools.html): Official registers and a few labelled tools. Some links are affiliate links.
- [Privacy policy](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/privacy.html): What the newsletter form collects (first name, email, and optional state).

## Optional

- [Longer summaries](https://australianbusinessstartup.com.au/llms-full.txt): The same pages, with the key facts written out.
